notes.title: 1.2 Update - Survivor Camp, New Area, New Items
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/f776747cb57407d6f6b2d65357245c4310ddc6c5.png[/img]

[h2]1. Added new area and added boss[/h2]

A new stage has been added. A group of survivors who are not related to the players have built a camp and are being attacked by zombies. The players set out on a journey with the hope that they will be safe if they enter the camp. There is a huge zombie guarding the entrance, so the players must break through it and enter the survivor camp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/487c183dff491e5e5e7c8213b90e4575a3df866c.png[/img]

However, the journey to the survivor camp will not be smooth for the players. The path to the survivor camp is blocked by an unidentified giant zombie, and no one has seen its true form yet.

[h2]2. Survivor Camp[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/929b4a8d34203903f5b45a3bb4d1ddb027e21bb2.png[/img]

Another group of survivors have built a camp based on the military base. They are fending off zombie attacks from inside. However, due to recent fierce battles, the number of defending troops has been greatly reduced.

The defending troops will protect the players and fight together. The goal for the players is to reach this camp.

[h2]3. Added in-game upgrade function[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/7cb20f76e36a12563b96b1f41556178c4663c46b.gif[/img]

Now, the upgrade that was done using gold teeth in the title can be done in-game as well. In-game upgrades use the upgrade points that you get when you acquire blueprints. So, previously, you could upgrade up to 5 slots, but now you can upgrade up to 8 slots by adding 3 in-game upgrades to 5 gold tooth upgrades.

This allows us to adjust the value of discarded blueprints and add randomness to the in-game.

If you get a powerful bonus from the first in-game upgrade, the game will be very smooth.

** When you research, you can gain experience for your weapon when you kill enemies. This experience can be used to get upgrade points.

[h2]4. Adding new enemies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/f32e036136b39139bfd44015a515bdeb468114d2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/f7b35a21c6ef3ac1d43349135f85e897d124262e.gif[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/0db738eaaf4286d057b3a2f1c4dcde4a168f03a7.gif[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/39fb13977a00ee6a5f530ab28d064824a3eb0998.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/b55dd4374e1e72e719a88bcf49cb9f12d15fa6c5.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/e6fb190b38cac1288b40f71e7250839bf30436cc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/28f4838dca74bbe979b64130b564aa5688661ea8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/4578745252e39aeef8b03e31c91f9707b7a8d92a.png[/img]

With the addition of a new area, various enemies have been added. In particular, the zombies that have turned into combatants in the survivor group have very strong attacks, so be careful.

In addition, there are enemies that throw mud that impedes the player's movement, and zombies that spread their attacks in difficult directions, so please be extra careful.

[h2]5. New accessory added[/h2]

A force field has been added. As the attack power of new enemies has been further strengthened, players also need a means of defense. Force Field is an accessory that provides additional defense for a certain period of time when attacked. However, most Force Fields do not work well with ranged weapons, so you should read the tooltip carefully before using them.

[h2]6. Accessory Swap Possible[/h2]

We wanted players to have a play experience using various weapons. However, since the existing system required weapons to be combined with accessories, it was almost impossible to play with pistols and rifles interchangeably. However, since each weapon has its own strengths and weaknesses, there was the inconvenience of having to change accessories depending on the situation in order to play optimally.

To solve this, we added the accessory swap function. This makes it easier to play by using a halberd when fighting many enemies and a dagger when fighting a boss.

Since this is a function for players who are skilled at playing, we made it possible to unlock it through research.

[h2]7. Apply Save/Load Slots[/h2]

LLD was originally a game made exclusively for multiplayer. However, as it has been proven that many players enjoy playing as a single player, the save slot function has been added. Now, up to 3 save slots are supported, making it easier to play with various characters.

[h2]8. Addition of farmable corpses[/h2]

Some corpses will now remain corpses instead of becoming zombies. You can now search these corpses for items. In the future, it will be used more actively to create a dark atmosphere.

[h2]9. Others[/h2]

Several chronic bugs have been fixed.

Several BGMs have been added.
A number of achievements have been added.

notes.title: Update 1.1 released - new map selection, new boss, new trait
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/c3c90052f16a75735eeb6956a88a6932ee205b9f.gif[/img]

[h2]Changes to the way terrain is selected[/h2]

The way terrain is selected is changing. The old way of doing things tended to lead to players playing the same terrain over and over again, so we're making changes to ensure that there's as much variety as possible.

Players will now have a different path to clear in each area before moving on to the next.

This makes player choice even more important, especially since some areas have two field bosses.



[h2]New Bosses[/h2]

- We've added Zombie Ball and Walker Brute zombies. Players have been asking for more variety in combat, so we're adding these bosses.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/17804d5b32246f3128af79620e2cde22dd6d3003.gif[/img]

A zombie ball is a giant ball of zombies. The more it is attacked, the more it splits apart. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/1b76ec7cd51165cc89ec653041dc31dc9e2e3da4.gif[/img]

And when it hits a wall, it has a pattern of scattering debris to threaten the player.


Roll, bump, scatter. It's a simple combination of patterns, but it makes for a formidable foe.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/5cc5ccb650d004d0f8070d24cf15839ce907dc30.gif[/img]

The Walker Brute zombie is a case of a construction worker turned into a powerful zombie, so it's an earth-shattering, rock-throwing attack. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/f467434b93ee9fcde8d7baae53c74154c8222066.gif[/img]

The mud left behind by spilling the ground will slow the player down if they step on it, and the Walker Brute zombies will periodically explode the mud, dealing a lot of damage to the player.

This means that the player has to fight the boss in a shrinking area. 

However, because it's a Stage 1 boss, its overall power is low, so it's designed as a "tutorial boss": it charges, throws rocks, flips the ground, and explodes.

It's a boss that collects the patterns of the bosses you'll be facing often in the future and gets players used to them.


[h2]New Melee Attack Trait[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/5f3dd4e6bbb2b19cc0cdf5b9784834650a88feda.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/54f05752e0721f57c02e3dc584c1cc32d9e270fc.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/4585a36899a4edc300eb61aba19508f6ee6d12fd.gif[/img]

Melee weapons now also have ranged attacks. This is earned by killing 250 or more zombies with a melee weapon, and the number of projectiles you have will be equal to the number of Treats you have earned, with each projectile being unique to the weapon. 

This will make it easier for players to take on ranged enemies with melee weapons.


[h2]Boss trait[/h2]

The 2 trait points previously earned by winning a boss battle have been deleted. Instead, if you win a boss battle, you can acquire a special trait. The design is that you will obtain a medicine that can obtain a trait, and if you eat it, you will obtain the corresponding trait.

I hoped that there would be special traits exclusive to bosses, and I also hoped that there would be more dialogue between players in multiplayer.


[h2]Balance changes[/h2]

- Eric now has an added 30% save chance for melee weapons. Melee weapons like chainsaws will be more effective.
- The blocking line that was the boss stage of stage 1 has been changed to stage 3.
- Watchers who could be dealt with on Hard difficulty can now be dealt with on Normal difficulty.
- The tree structure of weapon research has been slightly modified.


[h2]Bug fix[/h2]

- The % damage of weapon upgrades is now applied correctly.
- The issue of saves being deleted has been fixed.
- Fixed a bug where some weapons could not be unlocked.
- Fixed several other bugs.

notes.title: Version 1.0. Officially Released!
notes.content:
[h1]-Officially Released[/h1]

A spin-off project from the creation of ND's multiplayer features. Nearly Dead - Live and Let Die is now officially available. 

This patch aims to change the way you play the game by fixing a number of issues that have been bugging us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/2c698ba0a811273fb614b697a08ab53820fc3dd9.png[/img]

[h3]- Changing the game's direction and adding more public traits[/h3]


First of all, we tried to reduce the repetitiveness of the game. Previously, we categorized the traits into three categories (melee / ranged / utility) to make it easier to choose the right trait for the player's situation. However, this ended up making the player choose similar traits for each playthrough, which made it easy to feel repetitive after only three or four playthroughs.


And as we designed the game around that, we also realized that it was difficult to increase the difficulty.


So we added a lot of common traits, and the 40+ new character traits are very powerful, but because the old trait selection method removed the distinction between melee, ranged, and utility, it made it harder to pick the traits you wanted. So you could get lucky and pick the good ones easily, but if you were unlucky, you wouldn't see the good ones and the game would be harder.


We've also added a Talent Encyclopedia to help you keep track of all the new talents we've added. 


[h3]- Reducing the requirements for unlocking weapons and increasing their prices[/h3]

We've also significantly relaxed the requirements for unlocking weapons, which has been criticized. Weapons can now be unlocked by simply obtaining blueprints, instead of requiring a crafting count. We've also added powerful weapon upgrades, so that even low-tier weapons can be made more powerful with upgrades. This will be great for those who enjoy speedrunning.

However, the cost of the upgrades themselves has increased, and you'll need more cash, especially as more upgrades are only available through rerolls. 


[h3]- Addition of Elite Waves[/h3]


Elite zombies didn't appear often enough to pose a risk to players, so they didn't appear as active items, but now they will appear more often. With Elite Waves spawning randomly, it will be harder for players to stay on the same map for long. 

However, those who take that risk will be rewarded with active items.

Additionally, we're nerfing excessive Elite Waves in Region 3, which we've been criticizing.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/bd78439f89002e4a45baa0c0e39b1f084a8c2dc1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/f91505c159f6652a8d54423145573103d1c7e32d.png[/img]

[h3]- Two new melee weapons[/h3]

We've added two fun new melee weapons: a melee weapon that attacks in 360 degrees, and a giant bayonet. The giant bayonet in particular has a rifle tag, which gives you a lot more freedom in accessorizing.

notes.title: 23.09.02. Content Addition Patch
notes.content:
[h1]New Content[/h1]

[h2][*]New character, Natalia[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/69a74feef138de7da99d2bc9c1654e0000db3a69.gif[/img]

Natalia is a character specialized in energy weapons, including ice. Natalia, who was studying thermodynamics in the lab, was turned into a cat furry by a supernatural phenomenon. But using her expertise, good at using energy weapons, and you're particularly good at ice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/e7839f3bc5f4cd11795921c9397fc7c9d0e5776a.gif[/img]

So if freeze and kill a zombie, it causes a series of explosions. In addition, the cat's flexibility is used to evade enemy attacks.


[h2][*]New Elemental Weapons[/h2]

Five elemental weapons have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/b3511f0c780d9bb6d56442443874c5fb18fe6450.gif[/img]

Heavy flamethrower

-Enhanced from flamethrower, more powerful flame attacks can burn zombies to death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/e7839f3bc5f4cd11795921c9397fc7c9d0e5776a.gif[/img]

Ice drill

- A drill for spraying ice, a weapon specialized for freezing and breaking zombies. Due to the popularity of the chainsaw-type weapon, a similar ice weapon was created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/69a74feef138de7da99d2bc9c1654e0000db3a69.gif[/img]

Ice beam

- A weapon that can pierce through multiple enemies while freezing them to death in rapid fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/712da9238784674f3dc449c95c6b20048c5d8415.gif[/img]

Electric Zombie Swatter

- A melee weapon in the form of a giant electric flyswatter, designed to deliver an electric attack over a wide area, dealing heavy damage with stun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/16a1bc8432d4c6c5ce2e291d43eba48d6681cf1a.gif[/img]

Tesla discharger

- A weapon that fires electric waves in the shape of a crescent moon. We've created this weapon because of feedback about a fire weapon that can cover a large area of attack. Now you'll be able to wipe out enemy waves with ease.

[h2][*]New elemental damage rule[/h2]

Three elemental now have their own unique effects: fire, ice, and electricity. 

Fire has been given a character damage bonus, which means that its dot damage has been increased as well. This has improved the damage over time of fire weapons.

Ice can freeze you completely after a certain amount of stacks. When this happens, enemies become incapacitated and are completely defenceless. * Stronger enemies cannot be frozen.

Electricity causes a forced stun when stacked. As difficulty increases, it becomes harder to stun enemies, but electricity attacks are able to ignore that and force stuns.


In addition, Elemental Weapons have been buffed across the board, as they now deal more damage the longer they cause an enemy to be stunned.


[h2][*]New area[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540//c1d5da2896569eefb5edcfffd7c978f8d5ff118b.png[/img]

In addition to the new basemap, four new exploration areas have been added, and now on Hard difficulty and above, after killing a giant zombie, you can continue exploring in the Ruins area instead of going straight to face the Watchers.


[h2][*]New enemy[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/d162283e4c165374210daf3b87547fc0d2da2cf6.png[/img]

The Carver zombies have gotten stronger - they now have bony spinning saw blades on each arm, and if you get in contact with them, you'll take continuous damage. You'll need to watch for the saw stabbing motion and dodge accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/61309741a3a40442a1a880b10de5c2fe8ab12b2a.png[/img]

A zombie with two arms merged with a mortar has arrived, and your survivors will need to be constantly on the move to avoid the mortar rounds it fires in two consecutive shots.


[h1][*]Change[/h1]

[h2][*]Change the formula for damage[/h2]

Combined damage bonuses were previously calculated separately from % bonuses, now they are calculated together.

ex: If you have a pitchfork that deals 60 damage and grants a +50%, +50 bonus, it will now calculate as (60 * 1.5) + 50 = 140 damage, whereas before it would have calculated as (60 + 50) * (1.5) = 165 damage

[h2][*]Increased Enemy Damage[/h2]

Since enemies are dealing more damage overall, survivors will need to pay more attention to their armour.

[h2][*]Allow Shields on Thrown Weapons[/h2]

Some talents have been changed so that when they are unlocked by research, they can be applied directly without spending talent points.

[h2][*]Apply a scaling factor to health gains from food[/h2]

We've applied a scaling factor to the steady increase in health from food, so the amount of health you gain will now decrease as you eat.

notes.title: 23.07.20. some bug fixes
notes.content:
1. When multi-playing, we fixed the phenomenon that the entrance closes even if only one person enters the area of the main bros.

2. Fixed an issue where the HP of the client's monsters was not properly displayed when multiplayer.

notes.title: 23.07.15. New boss update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/946e13d2edc210a2b108bb254756f5c33b881edf.png[/img]


Bone Bros

A new boss has arrived. The Bone Bros is a variant of zombies that are more dangerous and possess strange powers than traditional zombies. They will fight the survivors using supernatural powers. 

There are three Bone Bros, and you'll have to fight them all at the same time. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/1fc97656980075641c157564fdfcc03d565af6e9.png[/img]

Bone Guard 

A warrior-type monster, designed to hold off ranged characters. It uses blunt slashing and charging attacks, but it can also deform its arms to shoot arrows, which inflict deadly debuffs on ranged characters. If killed, it destroys the Watcher's shield, and the Watcher will revive you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/e1568849ae68413c77f314de17a05b5bfd549752.gif[/img]

The Bone Stinger

A monster that uses its tongue as a whip to attack, designed to keep melee characters at bay. It moves by jumping, and will be a very annoying foe as it constantly attacks through its tongue. When killed, it destroys the Watcher's shield, and the Watcher will revive it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/6176401af1b2db04c4cb22181073bc2a96b531f1.gif[/img]

Bone Watcher

This boss is effectively the main body of the Bone Bros. It has a giant liver eyeball on its head and a giant mouth underneath. 

The Watcher is a real boss, controlling Guards and Stingers, firing lasers from its eyes and firing giant energy balls. It uses a shield that makes it invulnerable to player attacks, and you'll need to kill a Guard or Stinger to break that shield. 


Now, if the previous bosses were too monotonous for you, we've got a boss with a slightly more complex pattern. You'll have to fight through a breathtaking battle where you'll be constantly dealing with Guards and Stingers while dodging the Watcher's attacks, and then attacking the Watcher once his shield is broken.


Next time, we'll be back with a new area, new enemies, and new items related to the Bone Bros.


Bug fixes.

- Fixed an issue that caused AoE attacks to have an unusually wide hitbox.
- Fixed a bug where Grain Projectiles had a collision check.
- Fixed a bug where the Flame Whip had too many sound effects.
- Fixed a bug in the research tech tree.

notes.title: 23.05.13. Upgrades/research, added weapons/characters/traits, applied gore
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/f33791ab951768f0261694a7231d48240d9afa91.gif[/img]

[h1]1. Upgrade[/h1]

We've added the ability to upgrade your weapons so you can now take on tougher enemies and have a new experience every time you play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/596304fa8a7c15c8dc5666ebe892648146e39c20.png[/img]

Each weapon can be unlocked by spending Gold Teeth, which you earn each time you play the game, and upgrades can add more power. For example, adding "+1 extra projectile" to your sniper rifle will double its damage, or "AoE" to your longsword will allow you to attack over a wider area.

And unlocked weapons will be available from day one, regardless of blueprint acquisition, because they'll be craftable.


[h1]2. Research and Development[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/25b811fc1d6be03a1c58609126b0d1682cd149bf.png[/img]

You can now do research that applies to all of your characters, such as making your armor more effective, or taking less damage, or having more HP, or [b]mobile storage[/b].

And then there's special research. These can have powerful effects, such as doubling the maximum value of your armor or making you temporarily immune to damage.


[h1]3. Character Trait Research[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/51b05cc2b7403f11955ea2c979e6e579344dab65.png[/img]

Character-specific traits are now also unlocked through in-game currency, and instead of being available at startup, they're now available in-game via the trait selection screen.

Especially for Eric, the existing way of strengthening the drone has been changed. Now, the drone can only be strengthened by selecting the trait that appears in the game called Strengthen Drone, and it is no longer possible to strengthen it rapidly according to the crafting level.


[h1]4. Additional Weapons[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/a969e4ff281d2ff1ffcd1e246bcdceb567d28815.gif[/img]

The following weapons have been added: Flame Whip, Rocket Hammer, Pile spear, Silver Pistol, Silver Rifle, Holy Water, Slug Gun, Ugly Gun, and Laser Knife. A variety of powerful special weapons have been added to match the various weapon tags, and a new weapon tag called Exorcism Weapon has been added.


[h1]5. New Character, Benedict[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/9ef20faaa01efbadacea28084c01da581e9c9fa2.gif[/img]

Benedict has been added. Benedict has been an active exorcist since before the outbreak, and he hasn't stopped performing exorcisms on zombies. He just uses silver bullets and flammable holy water against zombies.

All of his weapons are AoE, and his AoE skills allow him to make AoE attacks even when using other weapons. You can use this to deal explosive damage to your enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/7d9946013e4a0bb1ff9efded0644b0a777752be4.gif[/img]


[h1]6. Changes to Margot[/h1]

Margot no longer only summons one type of minion - she can now control up to 8 minions, but she has increased her HP and added 2 more powerful minions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/0bc928805dce307112d957423c1bb0a8d0fe6857.gif[/img]

Stinger minions are mid-range minions that use their elongated tongues to attack enemies. You can summon up to 2 of them, and you must select a trait to summon them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/24bafce9e414c32ef129e6b74def3d2d88a3df9c.gif[/img]

Screamer minions are minions that use powerful shockwaves to make AoE attacks. You can only summon one, but they'll be a very powerful ally, as their attack range and power increase as they gain talents.


[h1]7. Add gory visual effects[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43557540/90bd2f8bd9600b2169e21d39427363feb3a12cc1.gif[/img]

Added gory visuals. Critical hits will now splatter blood around you, which will disappear over time.


[h1]8. Bug Fixes[/h1]

Critical bugs have been fixed. We apologize for any bugs that may have prevented you from playing.

Other issues such as GFX not being generated correctly and SFX not being called in time have also been fixed.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: 23.04.03. Added storage, increased Knox, adjusted difficulty, extracted langu
notes.content:
1. A storage have been added. Now you don't have to leave items on the ground. The storage will also be placed in boss raids, so you won't run out of ammo in boss fights.

2. Knox has become more powerful: not only does his Concentration effect now provide 100% Critical, but it also gives him an additional +1 Penetration. And his hunting dog, Max, can now join him. Max is a longtime hunting companion of Knox's, and he'll assist him when he attacks, causing zombies around him to take 20% more damage.

3. We've gotten some feedback that the 'Very difficulty' was too easy, so we've made some significant changes to the difficulty. The 'Very difficulty' should now be a satisfying difficulty for those looking for a challenge.

4. the language file has been extracted to output.json, so users can correct any incorrect translations. Thank you.

5. Added a armor slot. Previously, armor had to compete with other accessories. But now that enemies are getting stronger. We've added a slot for armor, which will allow you to spend resources to withstand attacks from more powerful enemies.

notes.title: 23.03.20. Bug fixes and laser rifle
notes.content:
the following bugs have been fixed:

1. The effect position of the laser pistol and laser rifle has been corrected.
2. The laser rifle now works properly and is suitable for killing large numbers of zombies.
3. A bug where flashbang sometimes did not work but still consumed energy has been fixed.

notes.title: 23. 03. 17. Add characters, add/change items, change UI, etc.
notes.content:
1. Added a character

- Added a new character, Margot, who has gained the ability to control zombie-like mutants in the lab, so the mutants she controls are not recognized as direct targets by the zombies.

She was also able to spray sticky fluids on the ground to help her escape pursuit.

Margot was designed to be a character that fights from a distance, using her minions to disrupt enemy attacks, and when chased by enemies, spraying sticky fluid to close the distance again. Margot also absorbs energy whenever she kills an enemy, so she's designed to be more active with more skills.


- - We've added a new character, Fael. After being turned into a werewolf, Fel is no longer afraid of zombies - to him, they're just delicious meat, and that delicious meat makes him stronger. 

Fael's growth is very different from previous characters. While all traditional characters gain HP by eating food, Fael grow stronger by killing zombies, and their attacks become more powerful.

Because of this, zombies have an instinctive fear of Fael, and are weakened in his presence.

Most of the existing characters have an advantage by running away from enemies, so we wanted to create a character that fights by moving forward, and that's what Fael is. Compared to Gregory, Fael is a more aggressive and active character.


2. Adding and changing items

- In LLD, it's all about the performance of your accessories, so paradoxically, the difference in the performance of the weapons wasn't that important. So we made the advanced weapons more powerful, and now you'll have to pay attention to what the weapons are. 

- Miniguns were classified as rifles and received bonuses, machine guns were added, and recoil buffers, an accessory for rifles, were added. 

- Pistols, SMGs, shotguns, etc. had their own characteristic and different uses, but rifles were all-around, but they didn't have that characteristic, and they didn't perform as well. So we made them stronger, and we also gave existing rifle accessories a slight performance boost.

- Grenades and grenade launchers have been buffed, making it easier to turn zombies into meat.

- Added archery traits.


3. Difficulty Bug Fixes

- After listening to feedback that the Hard and Very Hard difficulties were too easy, we found a bug that was preventing the difficulty from being applied correctly. The difficulty should now be applied correctly.


4. Added item dictionary

- There are a lot of different items in LLD, but there was no way to keep track of them. We've created an item dictionary, and we'll be adding a zombie dictionary in the future.


5. Bug fixes and more

- A number of bugs have been fixed.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: 230225 - bug fix - map voting, etc
notes.content:
The following bugs have been fixed.


1. The problem of the game crashing when selecting a boss during map voting
2. The game crashes when random is selected during map voting on the first day
3. The problem of resetting the armor after throwing it away and picking it up again

notes.title: 230204 Patch Notes - Relocating Items, Adding Characters
notes.content:
1. Items have been completely relocated throughout.

- You can now acquire more various items, and obtaining blueprints has become more difficult.


2. Special weapon slots have been increased to 2.

- As you acquire various weapons, the number of special weapon slots has been increased to two. And the keybindings have also been modified.

Previously: Keys 1 to 4 used to use skills, but now they have been changed to select weapons. And the mouse wheel that used to zoom in/out has been modified to change weapons. Zoom in/out has been changed to page up/down keys.


3. New character Eric has been added.

- Eric is the 6th character who summons drones by consuming basic ranged weapons such as revolvers and pistols. The drone has a performance that gradually becomes stronger according to the production level, so another play style character has been added.
